title: Closing Reading of a Retired Fleet Unit — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
# Closing Reading of the Retired Unit

When a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans leaves a retired unit, the retired unit's closing reading follows the latest evidence of its use. The comparison point is the plan's last recorded visit reading. That is the highest odometer on the plan's redemption entries, whether reinstated or not; where the odometer at sale is higher, or there is no such entry, it is the odometer at sale.

| Evidence, in order | Closing reading |
|---|---|
| The retired unit has a repair-order check-in above the last recorded visit reading (Service Accounts and Repair Orders records) | The retired unit's highest check-in odometer |
| No such check-in, but a claim under the retired unit's Factory Basic Limited Warranty (Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage records) records an odometer above that reading | The highest such claim odometer |
| Neither | The plan's last recorded visit reading |

**Cases (hypothetical, last recorded visit reading 61,000).**
| Highest check-in on the retired unit | Highest Factory Basic Limited Warranty claim odometer | Closing reading |
|---|---|---|
| 64,350 | 66,000 | 64,350 (the check-in row applies first) |
| 61,000 | 63,900 | 63,900 (a check-in equal to the reading is not above it) |
| none | 59,000 | 61,000 |
| none | none | 61,000 |

Claims under other coverages of the unit, such as a powertrain or emissions warranty, are not read for this purpose.
